title: Cost reduction with purchasing options: Spot, On-Demand, Savings Plan [Hands-On]

cues.en: Hello my friends and welcome to this, your hands-on tutorial on optimizing infrastructure costs by selecting purchasing options between spot instances, on-demand instances,
cues.zh: 各位朋友，歡迎來到這堂實作教學。我們要透過選擇購買選項來最佳化基礎設施成本，包括 Spot 執行個體、隨需執行個體，

cues.en: and SageMaker savings plans.
cues.zh: 以及 SageMaker Savings Plans。

cues.en: So I'm gonna show you where these purchasing options are, either within SageMaker or AWS, because for example, you will see that you will find
cues.zh: 我要示範這些購買選項在 SageMaker 或 AWS 的哪裡，例如你會看到，

cues.en: the savings plans outside of the SageMaker AI service.
cues.zh: Savings Plans 位於 SageMaker AI 服務之外。

cues.en: So here we go.
cues.zh: 開始吧。

cues.en: Let's start with the spot instances versus on demand instances.
cues.zh: 先看 Spot 執行個體與隨需執行個體。

cues.en: So we're gonna go to the search bar, we're gonna enter SageMaker AI because that's indeed where you can find these two purchasing options.
cues.zh: 到搜尋列輸入 SageMaker AI，因為這兩種購買選項就在這裡。

cues.en: Amazon SageMaker AI, we won't even have to create any domain.
cues.zh: Amazon SageMaker AI，甚至不必建立網域。

cues.en: I can directly show them to you. I mean, where to find them.
cues.zh: 我可以直接示範，也就是告訴你去哪裡找。

cues.en: It's actually in the Training jobs, which we'll find in the left-hand panel, right under Training.
cues.zh: 其實在左側面板 Training 底下的 Training jobs。

cues.en: All right, training jobs. There you go.
cues.zh: 好，Training jobs，就在這裡。

cues.en: And if you click Create training job, by the way, these are our previous training jobs, which we can't delete, you know, they stay for a while in this Training jobs page.
cues.zh: 按 Create training job。順帶一提，這些是先前的訓練工作，無法刪除，會在 Training jobs 頁面保留一段時間。

cues.en: So indeed, if we click Create training job, well, you will see that there will be a lot of configuration to do.
cues.zh: 按 Create training job 後，你會看到很多設定。

cues.en: Here, you can enter job name, you enter IAM role, algorithm options, between some SageMaker built-in algorithms, your own algorithm, choose an algorithm.
cues.zh: 這裡可以輸入工作名稱、IAM 角色；演算法選項包括 SageMaker 內建演算法、自己的演算法，或選擇演算法。

cues.en: Well, you have many of them.
cues.zh: 選項很多。

cues.en: For example, remember that we did Tabular regression and Tabular classification?
cues.zh: 例如，記得我們做過表格資料迴歸與表格資料分類嗎？

cues.en: Well, you can choose the XGBoost model here, as you can see.
cues.zh: 如你所見，可以在這裡選 XGBoost 模型。

cues.en: And then, there you go, you have some more configuration.
cues.zh: 接著還有其他設定。

cues.en: But the topic of this tutorial is the purchasing options, and you will find them way under here.
cues.zh: 但這堂的主題是購買選項，要往下很遠才會看到。

cues.en: You can choose the instance type between all the different machine learning compute instances.
cues.zh: 這裡可以從各種機器學習運算執行個體中，選擇執行個體類型。

cues.en: So let's keep this one.
cues.zh: 先保留這個。

cues.en: You choose the storage volume per instance, how many of them you want, and some encryption keys you need.
cues.zh: 選每個執行個體的儲存磁碟區、需要幾個執行個體，以及所需的加密金鑰。

cues.en: This is the network configuration, the hyper parameters for fine tuning.
cues.zh: 這是網路設定，還有用於微調的超參數。

cues.en: And you will see, you will find soon the purchasing options, input data configuration.
cues.zh: 很快就會找到購買選項；這裡是輸入資料設定。

cues.en: Still not, so that's basically where you can configure input sources.
cues.zh: 還沒到，這裡基本上是設定輸入來源。

cues.en: Check point configuration, still not, output data configuration, still not.
cues.zh: Checkpoint configuration，還不是；Output data configuration，也還不是。

cues.en: And there you go.
cues.zh: 找到了。

cues.en: This is how you can configure, whether you want some spot instances versus some on demand instances for your machine learning model training.
cues.zh: 這裡可以設定機器學習模型訓練要使用 Spot 執行個體，還是隨需執行個體。

cues.en: okay? So there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這裡。

cues.en: If you want spot instances, you will enable this, Enable managed spot training, to indeed, "Save compute costs for jobs "that have flexibility in start in end times.
cues.zh: 若要用 Spot 執行個體，就啟用 Enable managed spot training。「對開始與結束時間具有彈性的工作，節省運算成本。

cues.en: "Amazon SageMaker will use spare capacity "only to run this job," and you can choose a maximum wait time in hours, or actually minutes or seconds, or even days.
cues.zh: Amazon SageMaker 將僅使用備用容量執行此工作。」還可以設定最長等待時間，以小時、分鐘、秒，甚至天為單位。

cues.en: So here we have 48 hours, and there you go.
cues.zh: 這裡是 48 小時，就是這樣。

cues.en: If you of course disable this, well you will have on-demand instances.
cues.zh: 當然，如果不啟用，就會使用隨需執行個體。

cues.en: Okay, good. So we have two out of three.
cues.zh: 很好，三種選項已介紹兩種。

cues.en: And now let me show you where you can find the third purchasing options, which are the savings plans.
cues.zh: 現在示範第三種購買選項 Savings Plans 在哪裡。

cues.en: Well, you won't find them in the Amazon SageMaker AI console, we'll have to go to another service, which we just saw in the previous tutorial on cost monitoring.
cues.zh: 在 Amazon SageMaker AI 主控台找不到它，得前往另一個服務，就是上一堂成本監控教學剛介紹過的。

cues.en: You will actually find them in Billing and Cost Management.
cues.zh: 它其實在 Billing and Cost Management。

cues.en: Yes, it doesn't seem very intuitive, but this is where you can find them.
cues.zh: 沒錯，可能不太直覺，但就是在這裡。

cues.en: You will find them in the left hand panel.
cues.zh: 你會在左側面板找到它。

cues.en: If you scroll down, you will see, you will find exactly, there you go, we can see them, Savings Plans.
cues.zh: 往下捲，就會看到；找到了，Savings Plans。

cues.en: So let's click Overview here, and I will show you exactly how you can purchase a savings plan, but a SageMaker Savings Plan, if you are ready to commit for one or three years
cues.zh: 按這裡的 Overview，我要示範如何購買 Savings Plan，也就是 SageMaker Savings Plan，適合願意承諾使用一年或三年，

cues.en: of use of your instance, and of course, if you want to minimize the cost.
cues.zh: 當然也希望盡量降低成本的情況。

cues.en: So here we go. Let's click Purchase a Savings Plan.
cues.zh: 開始吧，按 Purchase a Savings Plan。

cues.en: And you will see here, that you can select, indeed, the SageMaker Savings Plans.
cues.zh: 這裡就能選 SageMaker Savings Plans。

cues.en: And indeed, it applies to "SageMaker service usage, "regardless of Region, instance family, and components."
cues.zh: 它適用於「SageMaker 服務用量，不受區域、執行個體系列與元件限制」。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這裡。

cues.en: That's where you can find the SageMaker Savings Plans, if you're ready to use SageMaker for a long time, meaning one year or three years, and indeed, that's the first step
cues.zh: 如果準備長期使用 SageMaker，也就是一年或三年，就可以在這裡找到 SageMaker Savings Plans。設定的第一步，

cues.en: of configuring SageMaker Savings Plans.
cues.zh: 就是這裡。

cues.en: You have to choose a term between one year or three years.
cues.zh: 必須在一年或三年之間選擇承諾期間。

cues.en: Okay, so let's choose for example, 1-year, then Purchase commitment.
cues.zh: 例如選 1-year，再設定 Purchase commitment。

cues.en: That's the hourly commitment amount, meaning that you're ready to spend for your savings plan.
cues.zh: 這是每小時承諾金額，也就是願意為 Savings Plan 支付的金額。

cues.en: And so for example, if we enter $0.1, and then a payment option of All upfront, well, we will have a total cost, well actually an upfront cost,
cues.zh: 例如輸入 0.1 美元，付款選項選 All upfront，就會有總費用，其實是預付費用，

cues.en: because we chose All upfront, of $876.
cues.zh: 因為選了全額預付，金額是 876 美元。

cues.en: And if we choose, for example, $1, here, it'll be times 10, $8,760.
cues.zh: 若這裡改成 1 美元，就會乘以十，變成 8,760 美元。

cues.en: And however, if we choose, for example, Partial upfront, well we'll have a lower upfront cost of 4,380, but then the same total cost eventually
cues.zh: 但如果選 Partial upfront，預付費用會比較低，為 4,380 美元，不過最終總費用相同，

cues.en: as the one we had for All upfront.
cues.zh: 和全額預付時的總費用一樣。

cues.en: All right? And there you go.
cues.zh: 好，就是這樣。

cues.en: That's how you configure your savings plan, and eventually you add it to the cart.
cues.zh: 這就是 Savings Plan 的設定方式，最後再加入購物車。

cues.en: But of course I'm not gonna do this.
cues.zh: 當然，我不會真的執行。

cues.en: This was just to show you how to configure savings plans.
cues.zh: 這只是示範如何設定 Savings Plans。

cues.en: So there you go.
cues.zh: 就是這樣。

cues.en: Remember these three options for the exam in order to optimize your machine learning infrastructure costs.
cues.zh: 考試要記住這三種選項，用來最佳化機器學習基礎設施成本。

cues.en: Now I look forward to seeing you in the next hands-on tutorial.
cues.zh: 期待在下一堂實作教學再見到你。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
